SUBTITLE: Activation-Aware Factorized SVD for Transformer Compression
CORE_BEHAVIOR_IN_ONE_SENTENCE: compresses dense transformer layers using activation-aware factorization and safe LayerNorm recalibration
LATENCY_REASON_SHORT: slightly more decompression work at inference
WHAT_WORKS: activation-aware weighting preserves the important directions with limited accuracy loss
WHAT_FAILS: extremely aggressive rank reduction can hurt sensitive layers
FAILURE_CONDITION: high compression pressure on fragile projection layers
LAY_SUMMARY: A3 compresses transformer layers by using real activation patterns to decide which directions are worth keeping. This makes the model smaller and cheaper to run while preserving most of the performance.
HIGH_LEVEL_DESCRIPTION: compresses dense linear layers using activation-aware SVD and a lightweight recovery stage
KEY_INSIGHT: the most important dimensions are not equally weighted, so the approximation should be guided by activation statistics
BEHAVIOR_1: keeps the dominant activation directions while reducing the model size
DIFFERENTIATOR: it uses activation-aware weighting instead of unweighted low-rank approximation
ENGINEERING_2: safe layer fallback when approximation quality is low
ENGINEERING_3: LayerNorm recalibration and LoRA recovery support
